initiative.title: Compact DSL redesign
initiative.summary: Replace dashboard text with a schema-driven outline language: defaults-aware export, one vocabulary, nested named composition nodes, annotations as children, define-once charts placed in views, and a layout block. Agent-written, human-reviewed; no backward compatibility.
initiative.next_action: Byron decides D1 (house style as library defaults) and D2 (name:w matrix widths); then start M1 (schema registry + normalized export).

sources.anchor: Run the intent process ... compact DSL ... composed stuff is terrible ... versatile, checkable, expressive and terse ... agent written and human reviewed
57 examples, 5,031 lines, 7,474 pairs; ~2,230 default-noise pairs; ~3,310 composition.* pairs; 29 compositions
exportParts diffs each chart against compileDocument(skeleton of head lines), not creation defaults; wrap() packs pairs into 64 columns
DSL_REFERENCE teaches x.title/x.min/bins while export writes xAxisLabel/xAxis.min/binCount
flat path encoding: indexes, []=, {}=, unset, null
elements (text, unit, guide, annotation, legend), marks (strip, point, path, span, band, summary, stack, ...), scales (position, value, numeric), calculations, overrides
six current exports and six hand conversions

claims.statement: Text must be readable by a human reviewer: every line carries meaning.
Composed graphics must have a first-class nested form; current composition text is unacceptable.
The language must be checkable: schema validation, precise diagnostics, exact round trips.
Expressive and terse; agent written, human reviewed or edited.
No backward compatibility required; existing syntax may be replaced.
One schema drives compile, export, validation, and reference so vocabulary cannot split again.
Calculation formulas keep their existing expression syntax.

options.name: Export defaults fix
options.premise: Diff against creation defaults; keep syntax.

options.name: Schema registry
options.premise: One per-type key table drives everything.

options.name: Indented outline
options.premise: Children by indentation; lists as repeated nodes.

options.name: Composition sublanguage
options.premise: Named nested units, marks, legends, notes; inferred scales.

options.name: Define once, place in views
options.premise: Top-level charts; views are layout + overrides.

brainstorm.selected_option: hybrid: o2+o3(brace form, per o4 structure)+o9+o10+o8(matrix)+at=, o1 first, o7 aggregate calls

shape.appetite: Full language replacement across every chart type and composition node, with all 57 examples round-tripping; rewritten in place.
shape.problem: Exported dashboard text is ~30% defaults and ~44% flat composition paths; vocabulary is split; views repeat charts; composition has no grammar.
shape.recommended_shape: Schema-registry-driven outline language with defaults-aware export, nested named composition nodes, chart-child annotations, define-once charts placed by view layout blocks, readable value forms, a set escape hatch, and fmt/check/reference tooling.
success_moves: Ship the defaults-aware export on the current syntax first: an independent ~30% reduction that also builds the registry's default table.
Make the registry the single source for compile, export, check, reference, and highlighting so docs cannot drift.
Use the 57-example round trip plus fmt idempotence (format(export(compile(t))) == format(t)) as the gate for every inference rule.
Keep a `set path=value` escape hatch so the language is complete before the registry is; check reports each use as a gap.
Test agent authorability with a cold agent and a one-page reference before building the parser; fall back to braces if indentation fails.
Convert composition last among grammars but prove its hardest example (middle-class-jobs) by hand in the first proof.

first_proof.try: Registry for scatter/row/hist + defaults-aware export over the corpus; cold agent writes 6 example dashboards (2 compositions) from a one-page draft reference.
first_proof.observe: Pair reduction for those types with 57/57 round trips; first-pass clean drafts; composition settings needing set.
first_proof.decide: >=4/6 clean brace-syntax drafts and set <5% of composition lines proceeds; otherwise widen the composition grammar first. If the matrix covers under ~80% of example layouts, make at= the export default.

failures: top-level placement of defined charts undefined

first_proof.question: Can agents write the brace syntax and composition grammar from a short reference, and how much text does the registry and matrix remove?
first_proof.decision_rule: >=4/6 clean brace-syntax drafts and set <5% of composition lines proceeds; otherwise widen the composition grammar first. If the matrix covers under ~80% of example layouts, make at= the export default.

rabbit_holes: Inference that cannot be reversed exactly (implicit scales, theme text styles, label-derived axis titles).
Implicit names colliding or changing when a field is renamed.
Splitting shared vs per-view chart state on export.
Matrix cannot express uneven splits such as 7/5; those charts fall back to at=.
Brace recovery: a missing } must not swallow the rest of the file.
House style differs from library defaults; 21% of exported pairs depend on a product decision.
decisions: Braces only for nesting; whitespace never carries meaning; fmt re-indents. Indentation is not a second syntax (Byron, 2026-10-11).
Placement by exactly one of at=x,y,w,h (always exact) or a layout matrix whose lines split 12 columns evenly; export writes the matrix where exact, at= otherwise (Byron, 2026-10-11).
